activity_summary: After dark a neighbour stood on the step and would not come in. He had heard that apprentices went against the Counter in the Poultry and took the prisoners out. He had not seen it. Verbeke had been at his loom. Mistress Ansell kept the bar in her hand. She said yesterday butter, today a prison, and that they had left off asking. You said yesterday's butter was fourpence. She sent the neighbour away, barred the door, and sent you up on one candle.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked whether the neighbour had seen it, named yesterday's fourpence, and went up.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept the bar, gave the butter and the prison their sentence, and barred the door.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Said he had heard the loom and then the knock, and sat in.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
